_comment: Development seed catalog: a small, genre-spread set of films so the
embedding and search code can be built and tested without a TMDB API key.
tmdb_id values start at 9000001, a reserved range far above any real TMDB
id. That keeps seed rows from colliding with the real catalog. Overviews
here are short factual plot summaries written for this fixture, not TMDB
text, so the file carries no third-party content.

movies.title: Arrival
movies.overview: A linguist is recruited by the military to find a way to communicate with visitors who have landed on Earth, and what she learns reshapes how she understands her own life.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.overview: With Earth's crops failing, a former pilot leaves his children behind to search through a wormhole for a habitable world, knowing the journey may cost him decades with them.

movies.title: Blade Runner 2049
movies.overview: A bioengineered enforcer uncovers a secret that could unravel society, and goes looking for a man who vanished thirty years earlier.

movies.title: Children of Men
movies.overview: Two decades after humanity stopped being able to have children, a disillusioned bureaucrat is asked to escort a pregnant woman to safety through a collapsing Britain.

movies.title: Solaris
movies.overview: A psychologist sent to a research station orbiting a strange planet finds the crew haunted by physical manifestations of the people they have lost.

movies.title: Moon
movies.overview: A man nearing the end of a long solitary shift mining on the lunar surface begins to suspect the company has not told him the truth about his contract.

movies.title: Heat
movies.overview: A disciplined crew of professional thieves plans one last large score while a relentless detective closes in, each man recognising himself in the other.

movies.title: Inception
movies.overview: A specialist in stealing secrets from inside dreams assembles a team for a job that requires planting an idea instead of taking one.

movies.title: Ocean's Eleven
movies.overview: A newly released con man recruits ten specialists to rob three Las Vegas casinos on the same night.

movies.title: No Country for Old Men
movies.overview: A welder who takes a case of cash from a drug deal gone wrong is pursued across Texas by a killer who cannot be reasoned with.

movies.title: Zodiac
movies.overview: A newspaper cartoonist becomes consumed by the hunt for an unidentified serial killer, and the investigation outlasts the careers of everyone chasing it.

movies.title: Prisoners
movies.overview: When two young girls disappear, a father's desperation pushes him past the law while a detective works the case by the book.

movies.title: Get Out
movies.overview: A young photographer visits his girlfriend's family estate for a weekend and slowly realises the warmth he is being shown conceals something far worse.

movies.title: Hereditary
movies.overview: After their grandmother's death, a family begins to come apart as they discover what has been passed down to them.

movies.title: The Babadook
movies.overview: A widowed mother struggling to cope with her son's fears finds that the creature from his picture book has started to feel real to her too.

movies.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
movies.overview: A celebrated concierge and the lobby boy he takes under his wing are drawn into a dispute over a priceless painting and a murdered heiress.

movies.title: Paddington 2
movies.overview: A polite young bear is wrongly convicted of theft and makes the best of prison life while his adopted family works to clear his name.

movies.title: Spirited Away
movies.overview: A sullen girl whose parents are transformed into pigs must work at a bathhouse for spirits to win their freedom and remember her own name.

movies.title: Toy Story
movies.overview: A cowboy doll who has always been his owner's favourite is threatened by a flashy new spaceman toy, and the two are forced to rely on each other.

movies.title: Manchester by the Sea
movies.overview: A withdrawn handyman returns to his coastal hometown to care for his teenage nephew and has to face the loss he moved away to escape.

movies.title: A Monster Calls
movies.overview: A boy whose mother is gravely ill is visited nightly by an ancient tree creature who tells him stories that help him name what he is afraid to say.

movies.title: Dunkirk
movies.overview: Allied soldiers trapped on a French beach wait for rescue while civilian boats cross the Channel to reach them.
Two young soldiers are sent across enemy ground to deliver a message that will stop an attack and save a battalion.

movies.title: Before Sunrise
movies.overview: Two strangers meet on a train and spend a single night walking through Vienna, talking, before they have to part.

movies.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
movies.overview: After a painful breakup, a man undergoes a procedure to erase his former partner from his memory and changes his mind midway through.

movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movies.overview: A drifter is swept into the escape of a group of women fleeing a warlord across a desert wasteland in a single sustained pursuit.

movies.title: Parasite
movies.overview: A family living in a cramped basement talks its way one by one into jobs with a wealthy household, until the arrangement turns on them.

movies.title: Whiplash
movies.overview: A young drummer at an elite conservatory is pushed to the edge by an instructor who believes cruelty is the only thing that produces greatness.

movies.title: The Lives of Others
movies.overview: A state security officer assigned to spy on a playwright in East Berlin is gradually changed by the life he is listening to.

movies.title: Groundhog Day
movies.overview: A cynical weatherman is trapped reliving the same small-town February day until he stops trying to game it and starts trying to be better.
